agreed.compute_sharing: One signed INT8 GEMM datapath for projections, QK^T, PV and lm_head; K/V are matrix operands, not restored BF16 weights.

scale_groups.A: up to 16 rows, common scale across the complete reduction K
scale_groups.B_weight: up to 16 output channels, common scale across the complete reduction K
scale_groups.Q: per query head and up to 16 queries, across all 64 head dimensions
scale_groups.K_cache: one static scale per layer/KV head, shared by all up-to-16-token tiles and all 64 dimensions
scale_groups.P: per query head and up to 16 queries, across the entire valid context
scale_groups.V_cache: one static scale per layer/KV head/16-feature group, shared across all context tokens

agreed.dynamic_scale_rule: FP32_RNE(max_abs_or_max/127); all-zero block has scale 1 and integer values 0
agreed.calibration: Excluded for now; assume matching prepared weights/static scales exist, without claiming assets have been obtained or quality validated

executor_boundaries.gemm: shared INT8 core plus FP32-scale/BF16 output path
executor_boundaries.attention: head mapping and layout/transpose adapters around shared GEMM
executor_boundaries.nonlinear_vector: RMSNorm, RoPE, Softmax, SiLU and residual engines; detailed numerical algorithms remain pending

weight_pingpong.method: explicit PS-issued ISA, two independent weight banks
weight_pingpong.compute_and_load: GEMM on one bank may overlap DMA_LOAD of weight and scale into the other; no autonomous prefetch
weight_pingpong.scale_table_relocation: B7 static subregion to keep four-bit bank IDs

agreed.quantization_evaluation: FP32 division followed by nearest-even integer rounding and saturation; no reciprocal substitution

GEMM_implementation.compute: N16 x K16 SIMD, 256 INT8 products/cycle staged capacity
GEMM_implementation.GQA_reuse: three query heads per KV head; up to96 logical rows

preconditions: accumulator cleared for each new output tile
partial sums retained only across its reduction tiles

not_yet_agreed: nonlinear internal algorithms, precision and approximation criteria
final calibration/evaluation dataset and quality/performance targets
implementation_status: Binary codec and scoped synthetic tensor interpreter verified; GEMM implementation contract frozen by user approval; RTL/synthesis/board not started.
